reviews.reason: The related-capability search and complete 14-entry registry contain observation, gathering and transfers, but no planting or persistent cultivation trial. probe can inspect material but cannot establish a planted specimen or track growth. Develop a small propagation trial in the current-conversation handoff; edible identity does not establish propagation viability. The currently observed source has 3 stock, not its initial 6. Current-conversation fallback review: both model submissions remain rejected for quoted numeric learning. This review adopts the minimum nonproducing observation precursor and corrects that type explicitly; it is not an accepted model review.
reviews.specification: Implement a one-specimen root-planting trial, not guaranteed food production. Inputs: an explicitly selected owned root unit and a visible, reachable, unoccupied ordinary-soil patch; validate actual soil access and hand-workability before committing. Candidate material is item-3-moss-12, quantity 2, origin start-1-roots; revalidate ownership, remaining quantity and decay at execution. The observed parent is start-1-roots at (20.1,14), revision foundation-forest@1; it is not an automatic material source. Soil moisture 0.65 is an observation, not an inexhaustible water supply or proof of suitability. Record reuse of open.probe foundation-open@1 for actual inspections, kernel.navigate and forest.gather foundation-forest@1 for separately chosen travel or collection, and existing inventory, decay and world-clock code; do not reimplement or silently execute those actions. Planting requires individual study, reach within 0.65 of the validated patch, one surviving root unit and sufficient energy. Cost: 2 active rounds, 1 energy each, and transfer of exactly 1 root unit into a persistent planted specimen; no tools, fertilizer or added water are supplied. If hand preparation is physically infeasible, stop before consuming material and report that constraint. Store exact material provenance, patch coordinates, committed units, work 0/2 through 2/2, timestamps and observed conditions. Reserve the root at start without duplicating it; on completion move its surviving mass into the planted state, no longer edible inventory. Interrupted work pauses with its progress and decay intact; resume revalidates access and material. Cancel or actor death releases surviving unplanted escrow once at the actual location, never refunds spent effort or decayed material, and never recreates planted material. Completed specimens persist independently of the actor. Global pauses and development/review waiting advance neither work nor biology. Minimum executable outcome is a planted-material observation trial: inspect using probe at its existing one-round, 0.2-energy observation cost, with no automatic maintenance or watering. Bound the initial observation interval to 30 advancing world rounds, then report measured status or inconclusive; this is not a maturation deadline. Reuse an existing biological updater only if the handoff verifies it. Otherwise implement persistent burial/exposure and observation first, without asserting germination, death or yield from elapsed time alone. Growth and replenishment require a coded, disclosed-in-contract biological model with material viability, moisture use, environmental energy, substrate limits, decay and stage thresholds; no invented hidden-resource facts may be exposed. Any eventual edible stock must have measured maturation, explicit biomass/input accounting and finite stock, with gathering transferring it rather than duplicating it. No stock reset to capacity, immediate nutrition, automatic recovery or free regrowth. Maintenance beyond inspection requires separately available inputs and actions. Unknown or unsupported propagation remains an informative trial limitation, not a permanent rejection or an invented tool-development roadmap.
reviews.experienceReview: No experience or pleasure for requesting, registration, study, planting labels or assumed success. A genuinely observed applicable survival, sprouting, decay or informative failed-propagation result may qualify only through the existing verified-information event rules, deduplicated by specimen, tested question and evidence; no new reward account or reward-writing mechanism is authorized. If those bounded rules are unavailable, award zero pending their implementation. Repeated unchanged inspections give no information-gain benefit. No automatic satisfaction, comfort, healing or nutrition is granted; nutrition remains 14 per actually consumed root unit, toxicity 0, independent of mood. Ordinary metabolism and costs continue during active simulation.
reviews.visualReview: Emit observable events only for completed preparation, actual planting, inspection findings and subsequently verified biological changes. Reuse plant visual metadata with stable specimen ID, coordinates, source provenance, stage, observedAt and status; distinguish work-in-progress, planted-unverified, confirmed living/sprouted, confirmed decayed/dead and inconclusive. Initially show buried material or a neutral plot marker, not a mature edible plant. Progress reflects completed work only; blocked, cancelled or failed actions never display planting success, growth or harvest. Do not reveal unobserved viability or remote changes through the visual layer.
